subject: Follow-up: Private deployment requirements & regulatory checklist for CoreHealth
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Kent <laura.kent@corehealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Private deployment requirements & regulatory checklist for CoreHealth

Laura — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so we keep momentum going.

Recap (from call):
- CoreHealth is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) for a PHI-containing workflow (clinical notes ingestion) and needs both HIPAA controls and GDPR data residency for some EU/UK cohorts.
- Primary ask: isolation (no public egress), audit logging, hardware-backed key management, and evidence for SOC 2 scope (in-progress).
- Timeline: procurement and security review over the next 6–8 weeks; goal to run a pilot within 10–12 weeks.

Immediate asks / next steps we discussed:
1) Please complete the attached vendor questionnaire (CoreHealth_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx) and return by EOD Thu 2027-04-29 so our security team can prioritize.
2) Share any high-level network diagram you have (we referenced a quick sketch on the call). If you send a PDF that’s perfect — we attached our private deploy checklist for reference.
3) SOC 2 status: you mentioned an external auditor engaged and a target for Type II in Q3. Could you confirm whether there are any control gaps we should pre-empt (encryption at rest, account mgmt, change control docs)?
4) Technical deep-dive: propose Tue 2027-04-27 10:00–11:00 PT for an SRE/security session with Marissa & Soojin to review network isolation and air-gapped options. Please confirm availability.

Notes for the internal team (cc’d):
- Marissa: lead the architecture deep-dive and propose an initial private deploy reference diagram that satisfies "no egress" and HSM/KMS integration.
- Soojin: flag any SOC 2 evidence we must prepare prior to the pilot (matrix + sample artifacts).
- Karthik: track procurement milestones and attach to the HubSpot deal.

Attachments: CoreHealth_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx (attached), redwood_private-deploy-checklist.xlsx (attached).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if useful.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Kent <laura.kent@corehealth.io>

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private deployment requirements & regulatory checklist for CoreHealth

Dylan — thanks for the clear recap and timeline. Quick responses inline: 

1) Questionnaire: attaching a nearly-complete file (we filled most fields; see note column). I will finish the outstanding items by Thu 2027-04-29.
2) Network sketch: attached (corehealth_network_sketch_v0.1.pdf) — it’s a first pass from our infra team showing our primary datacenter and peering. The important constraint is that the PHI processing cluster must not have any outbound internet access (egress) and must sit behind our perimeter firewall.
3) SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type I report from last year and engaged an auditor for Type II — target reporting window Q3 2027. Current gaps: we do not yet have a formal documented key-rotation schedule for our in-house KMS and some change-control artifacts are still draft. We can provide interim evidence and a remediation timeline.
4) Deep-dive: Tue 2027-04-27 10:00 PT works for me; I’ll ask our site reliability lead (Paul) to join.

A couple of clarifications we need from Redwood to prepare:
- Do you support an air-gapped deployment (fully isolated, manual artifact transfer) or do you recommend a locked-down VPC with egress filtering? If both are possible, what are the incremental pieces and typical costs?
- KMS: can you integrate with our HSM via PKCS#11? We prefer hardware-backed keys for private deploys.

We’ll send the finished questionnaire and any additional diagrams before Thursday.

Thanks,
Laura Kent
VP Product & Security Operations | CoreHealth
laura.kent@corehealth.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Kent <laura.kent@corehealth.io>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private deployment requirements & regulatory checklist for CoreHealth

Laura / team — great, thanks for the sketch and the SOC 2 transparency. Two quick clarifications from the infra/security side ahead of tomorrow's deep-dive: 

Technical notes / preliminary positions:
- Deployment modes: we support two approaches for your use case:
  * Dedicated VPC (recommended start): full network isolation inside a customer VPC with strict egress controls, customer-managed firewall rules, and optional NAT disabled for processing subnets. This gives typical onboarding speed (2–6 weeks) and keeps patching/ops in Redwood's managed plane while data plane sits in your VPC.
  * Air-gapped on-prem: fully isolated, no network egress, manual artifact ingestion via signed images and offline transfer. This is a heavier lift (hardware procurement + onsite install) and typically a longer timeline and higher fixed cost; we can share a checklist.

- KMS / HSM: we integrate with PKCS#11-compatible HSMs and can also support cloud KMS (customer-managed) if you run in a cloud region. For HSM we will need a documented key provisioning flow and HSM access window for initial key load.

- Audit & logs: we can surface per-request audit logs and integrate with your SIEM via a secure logging endpoint (TLS with mutual auth). We will propose a minimal evidence pack for SOC 2 reviewers (config docs, access lists, audit logs, change-control samples).

Action items before the deep-dive (owners + dates):
- Laura / CoreHealth: return questionnaire by Thu 2027-04-29 and attach any network ACLs or firewall rules. (Laura)
- Dylan: create a draft private-deploy reference diagram that satisfies the "no egress" constraint and include HSM/KMS touchpoints. (Dylan) — target Mon 2027-04-26 EOD.
- Soojin: compile an evidence checklist for SOC 2 Type II reviewers and identify our standard artifacts; share by Tue 2027-04-27 09:00 PT. (Soojin)
- Marissa: lead the technical deep-dive tomorrow; prepare a cost/effort estimate for air-gap vs locked VPC. (Marissa)

Attachments referenced: redwood_private-deploy-checklist.xlsx (internal), and I’ve added a quick stub link to a draft diagram we’ll use in the session: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cCoreHealthSharedDocs

Looking forward to the call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

One more ask: could Redwood share a short outline of the evidence artifacts you typically provide for SOC 2 Type II reviewers (a checklist or sample doc)? If you can send that ahead of the call it will help our compliance lead prep.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Laura
